description: Reply to a comment on one of the workspace's published posts. The reply is posted publicly on the platform right away, as the channel the post was published to, and it cannot be taken back from here. Up to 2,000 characters. If the channel's connection has stopped working, the call is refused and the channel needs reconnecting from the Channels page. Comment replies are on every plan except Free; on Free, or before they are available to the account, the call is refused with a message saying so. Use this when the user wants to answer a comment on one of their published posts.

rootCommentId.description: When replying to a reply: the thread's top-level comment id (Instagram and YouTube).
